title: G Flip’s ‘Bed On Fire’ Tour Will Rage Through North America This Summer
summary: G's latest trek gets underway Aug. 4 at New York City’s Bowery Ballroom, and will include dates in Boston, Toronto, Chicago, Los Angeles, Seattle, Nashville, and elsewhere.
contentText:
Get ready to flip out: G Flip will take their Bed On Fire tour through North America this summer.

The Australian singer, songwriter and multi-instrumentalist launches the trek off the back of “Bed On Fire,” which too is on fire after it was synced in Amazon’s Off Campus series. G Flip’s latest coast-to-coast visit gets underway Aug. 4 at New York City’s Bowery Ballroom, and will include dates in Boston, Toronto, Chicago, Los Angeles, Seattle, Nashville, and elsewhere.

Also, G will headline Chicago Pride on June 21, and perform at Brighton Pride on Aug. 1, before supporting Robbie Williams’ BRITPOP Australian stadiums jaunt this November.

It’s been another hot run for the multiple ARIA Award-winning Sydney artist, who recorded the official song for the 2026 AFC Women’s Asian Cup , and performed a mini-set at the soccer tournament’s grant final.

Since then, “Bed On Fire” has been sizzling. On the latest ARIA Singles Chart, it has snagged a new peak position, up 33-28; the cut sits at No. 2 on Billboard’s Alternative Digital Song Sales chart; and it crashed Billboard’s Hot Rock & Alternative Songs tally, with a peak of No. 46.

Following the premiere of Off Campus in May, the tune has seen total streams surge by more than 650%, according to reps, with over 86% of its lifetime streams generated during that period. Total worldwide streams have flown by 20 million.

G has been in record-setting form in their homeland, where in early 2024, they established a then-record by landing a total of seven songs in triple j’s Hottest 100 countdown, including the No. 2 ranked track, “The Worst Person in the World”. That bettered the mark previously held by rock trio Wolfmother, which scored six entries in a countdown two decades earlier, in 2005 (Charli xcx and Billie Eilish have since raised the bar, with eight entries each).

Earlier, in 2023, G landed a first ARIA No. 1 album with  DRUMMER , released via Future Classic/Universal (their debut from 2019,  About Us , peaked at No. 6), and bagged two ARIA Awards.

“Bed On Fire” appears on their third studio album,  Dream Ride  (via AWAL Recordings), which G described as their “little ‘80s Butch Springsteen fantasy.” Dream Ride motored to No. 4 on the ARIA Albums Chart  last September .

The general ticket onsale for the Bed On Fire tour starts today, June 18 at 10am. Visit gflipmusic.com/tour for more.
